newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates up.
newsitem.headline: Egypt pound overnight, one-week rates up.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound rose in a short private sector market to between 10 and 10-1/4 percent from Thursday's range of 9-1/2 and 10 percent, bankers said.
One week rates went also up to 10-1/4 and 10-3/8 percent from around 10 percent.
The Central Bank offered a 500 million pound repo ($147 million) on Sunday, one banker said. It is valid for four days.
A previous 500 million pound repo will also mature on Thursday, making the market very liquid by the end of the week, the banker told Reuters.
Public sector banks maintained their minimum overnight lending rates at 10-1/2 percent.
